**Finding: deviation (medium) — § 4(a), paragraph p0016**

The renewal mechanic auto-renews for successive 1-year terms (term length is acceptable), but the only way out after the Initial Term is a **90-day** termination-for-convenience notice — at the walk-away boundary and well beyond our preferred 30-day / fallback 60-day window. There is no express non-renewal right and no vendor reminder ahead of renewal.

Redline (validated, ok:true): notice shortened to 30 days, an express non-renewal election added, and Kubient required to give written notice of the upcoming renewal 60 days before term end. No uplift cap was proposed since compensation is an Exhibit-based revenue share, not a fixed fee subject to renewal increases; fallback of 60 days' notice offered in the comment.
